smoke_source.text:
"""Task-specific exact-package acceptance; run outside its source checkout."""
import hashlib
import importlib.abc
import importlib.metadata as metadata
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import platform
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import types
from packaging.specifiers import SpecifierSet

prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)

class NoAckredit(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname == 'ackredit' or fullname.startswith('ackredit.'):
            raise ModuleNotFoundError(fullname)
blocked = NoAckredit()
sys.meta_path.insert(0, blocked)
import citation_provider as provider
assert provider.normalize([1, 3]) == [0.25, 0.75]
assert 'ackredit' not in sys.modules
assert not metadata.distribution('ackredit-example-provider').requires
assert pathlib.Path(provider.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(prefix)
sys.meta_path.remove(blocked)

import ackredit
from ackredit.core.registry import Registry
from ackredit.core.cff import find_and_parse_cff
assert metadata.version('ackredit') == ackredit.__version__ == '0.12.0'
assert pathlib.Path(ackredit.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(prefix)
assert str(find_and_parse_cff(pathlib.Path(ackredit.__file__).parent)['version']) == '0.12.0'
assert SpecifierSet(metadata.metadata('ackredit')['Requires-Python']) == SpecifierSet('>=3.11,<3.15')
original = provider.normalize
with ackredit.session('archive-installed author'):
    declaration = ackredit.validate_provider(provider)
    assert declaration['software'] == {'name':'Citation Example','version':'2.4.0'}
    assert provider.normalize is original and not Registry.items and not ackredit.get_used_items()
    declaration['software']['version'] = 'detached edit'
    assert provider.__ackredit__['software']['version'] == '2.4.0'
    with ackredit.observe_calls(provider), ackredit.capture('installed example', record_evidence=True) as run:
        assert provider.normalize([1,3]) == [0.25,0.75]
    assert provider.normalize is original
    attribution = run.attribution
    evidence = run.evidence
    assert {x['id'] for x in attribution.to_dict()['items']} == {'example:software:2.4.0','example:article'}
    assert evidence is not None
    (out/'attribution.json').write_text(attribution.to_json())
    (out/'evidence.json').write_text(evidence.to_json())

empty = types.ModuleType('release_empty_roles')
empty.compute = lambda: 7
empty.__ackredit__ = {'schema':'ackredit.provider@1','software':{'name':'Release empty-role fixture','version':'1'},'items':[{'id':'release:empty','type':'article','title':'Empty role fixture'}],'functions':{'compute':[{'item_id':'release:empty','roles':[]}]}}
with ackredit.session('archive-installed empty roles'):
    registry_before = json.loads(json.dumps(Registry.items))
    value = ackredit.validate_provider(empty)
    assert value['functions']['compute'][0]['roles'] == []
    assert Registry.items == registry_before and not ackredit.get_used_items()
    with ackredit.observe_calls(empty), ackredit.capture('unspecified role') as captured:
        assert empty.compute() == 7
    saved = ackredit.Attribution.from_json(captured.attribution.to_json())
    assert saved.to_dict()['uses'][0]['roles'] == []
    assert '| Not recorded |' in saved.report('workflow')
    (out/'empty-roles.json').write_text(saved.to_json())

assert importlib.util.find_spec('duecredit') is None
from ackredit._private.smonitor.exceptions import AckreditError
try:
    ackredit.export_to_duecredit()
except AckreditError as error:
    assert 'duecredit' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('Actual absent optional engine must diagnose')

reader = r'''
import importlib.abc, json, pathlib, socket, sys
class NoProducer(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname.split('.')[0] in {'citation_provider','pyunitwizard','pint','unyt'}:
            raise AssertionError('producer import attempted')
sys.meta_path.insert(0,NoProducer())
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs): raise AssertionError('network or recording attempted')
socket.socket.connect = socket.create_connection = forbidden
import ackredit
from ackredit.core import collector,registry,session
from ackredit.cli import main
before=ackredit.get_attribution().to_dict()
items=dict(registry.Registry.items)
registry.register_item=collector.track_item=collector.aggregate=session.read=forbidden
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); original=(root/'attribution.json').read_bytes(); companion=(root/'evidence.json').read_bytes()
a=ackredit.Attribution.from_json(original.decode()); e=ackredit.AttributionEvidence.from_json(companion.decode())
assert a.to_json().encode()==original and e.to_json().encode()==companion
assert '10.1234/demo' in a.report('bibtex') and 'Untaken method' not in a.report()
assert e.report('workflow')==a.report('workflow')
bundle=ackredit.compose_attributions([a,a],name='reused original')
assert len(bundle.attributions)==2 and bundle.attributions[0].to_dict()==a.to_dict()
assert bundle.attributions[1].to_dict()==a.to_dict()
assert 'Citation Example' in bundle.report('workflow')
report=e.report('workflow',include_evidence=True)
assert 'Provider declaration' in report and 'Citation Example' in report
sys.argv=['ackredit','report',str(root/'evidence.json'),'--input-format','evidence','-f','workflow','--include-evidence','-o',str(root/'evidence.md')]
assert main()==0 and (root/'evidence.md').read_text()==report
assert (root/'attribution.json').read_bytes()==original and (root/'evidence.json').read_bytes()==companion
assert ackredit.get_attribution().to_dict()==before and registry.Registry.items==items
assert not {'citation_provider','pyunitwizard','pint','unyt'} & sys.modules.keys()
'''
process=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',reader,str(out)],cwd=out,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert process.returncode==0, process.stdout+process.stderr
providers={n:{'version':metadata.version(n),'origin':__import__(n).__file__} for n in ('ackredit','smonitor','depdigest','argdigest')}
assert all(pathlib.Path(v['origin']).resolve().is_relative_to(prefix) for v in providers.values())
result={'schema':'ackredit.release-installed-smoke@1','version':'0.12.0','python':platform.python_version(),'prefix':str(prefix),'providers':providers,'example_dependency_free':'passed','standalone_detached_validator':'passed','empty_roles':'passed','opt_in_evidence':'passed','producer_independent_reader_cli':'passed','saved_result_composition':'passed','actual_optional_absence':'passed','files':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(out.iterdir()) if p.is_file()},'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'limits':['Task-specific installed acceptance of retained example and empty-role fixture; not habitual use, platform matrix, science equivalence or external reference-manager qualification.']}
(out/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
